backfill_news.headline: Fire reported at Diamond Green Diesel Norco, Louisiana facility
backfill_news.summary: A fire was reported at Diamond Green Diesel's Norco, Louisiana renewable diesel facility on August 20. Darling Ingredients confirmed the facility was running following a 10-day outage.
